typed: I skip the mother and go straight to the hill gate. I want the guard to point me down the path to the savaged ewe, and I'll go alone.
note: Harra's answer was fine, but he said the child was last seen "at the well, not in the hall", which is a little odd. The game also didn't act on my "head out of town" and just redirected me.

typed: I ignore the advice, take the drove road alone and follow it past the wall toward the savaged ewe, keeping the stream on my left.
note: Fine. The captain gave clear directions and a warning. Harra's "far side of the common" and the captain's description are consistent.
Odds screen is clear, but it's unclear what "Go big" changes until I pick it. Also, a stealth sneak was offered when I'd said I charge in mace in hand.
Odds screen is clear. "Go big" rewording of success/failure is a bit abstract, but readable.
Near-miss screen is clear enough, though "exposure, serious" and "footing, serious" are a bit jargony. Menu lacks a Back/Explain consequence preview for what "serious" costs in Health.

typed: I burst out of the trees and charge the beast with my mace.
note: The result says I'm hidden but also noticed, which is a little muddled. The prose was good, though.
10% long shot with a Danger warning is brutal, but that's what I wanted. Slightly odd that the result said I was "hidden from view" while also noticed.

typed: I roll away from its head and scramble for my mace, then swing at it again.
note: Nice grim tension. The 10% charge was brutal, but the odds screen warned me clearly.
The last output ended with "you have one chance" but no odds screen or menu appeared, so I'm not sure what to type. Pressing Enter to see if the offer comes up.

typed: I grab the mace and swing at the beast.
note: My roll-away action got narration but no odds screen, and then the game said nothing was waiting, so I had to re-type. Felt like a dead end.

Odds are brutal (10%, 45% grave) after already being at Vitality 4, but that's what I asked for. The "Hurt the beast's lunge" label is a bit odd, since I'm swinging at it rather than stopping a lunge.

typed: I try to call out to the man shouting, as loud as I can manage.
note: Two grave hits in a row at 10% odds felt brutal, but the dread and the shout nearing worked. The Vitality 0 'staggered' state wasn't explained, so I don't know if I'm dying or out.

typed: I stab my thumb toward the beast's eye and shout for the man to hurry.
note: Last output ended without an offer, which is fine, but I'm at Vitality 0 and it's unclear what that means for me now. Is it death or just staggered?
